data.standardized_narrative: Insufficient extractable data from the provided scanned pages to determine a gross prior-year claims reserve opening balance or a verified gross prior-year development figure. The scanned images are low resolution and rotated, preventing confident extraction of the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (gross) value and the Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding (gross).
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as low-resolution rotated scans. Balance sheet line 'Claims outstanding' (gross) and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column could not be unambiguously read. The gross premiums written total (332.9) was visually identified on the Statement of Total Comprehensive Income (page 5) but class-level segmental analysis values and the technical reserves movement (gross) were not legible with confidence. No reliable gross prior-year development (PYD) figure could be located; therefore PYD fields are null. If higher-resolution, correctly oriented PDF/pages are supplied, a re-extraction can produce precise values and page references. Note: amounts in this JSON are in the report's native currency (GBP).
